title: RAMA Component Ablation on rel-f1/driver-position: 6 Aggregation Methods × 5 Seeds
summary: Demo notebook for the RAMA (Rank-Aware Moment Aggregation) component ablation study on rel-f1/driver-position. Implements 6 GNN aggregation methods (standard_mean, mean_layernorm, ungated_moment, rama_full, pna_style, rama_no_rank) with lightweight PyG-compatible shims. Runs unit tests verifying shape correctness, zero-init behavior, and gradient flow. Loads pre-computed training results (18 runs: 6 methods x 3 seeds) from mini_demo_data.json and reproduces the full statistical analysis including pairwise Cohen's d effect sizes and hypothesis tests. Visualizes results with MAE bar chart and Cohen's d heatmap. Key finding: RAMA variants (MAE~3.65) significantly outperform baselines (MAE~3.81).
